clue.text: Inclination to reserve an account of sums

parts.note: an inclination is a slope or bank, as of a river or road
to reserve a seat is to book it

explanation.surface: A tendency to set aside a report of arithmetic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is only a link joining the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A passbook records the deposits and withdrawals held at a bank, so it is a written record of money sums.

clue.text: Without having received a favour this creature would still be a bachelor

parts.note: BA is a Bachelor of Arts
a boon is a favour or blessing

explanation.surface: A creature that, had it not been granted a kindness, would have stayed an unmarried man.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue works backwards: take BOON (a favour) away and only BA (bachelor) remains, so the creature is BA plus BOON.
explanation.definitionFit: The animal is a large African monkey, and the clue points at it as 'this creature'.

clue.text: Pinch the Spanish for a piece

parts.note: to pinch is to steal, slang 'nick'
el is Spanish for 'the'

explanation.surface: Steal the Spanish word for a fragment.
explanation.definitionFit: A coin, especially the American five-cent coin, is called a piece of money.

clue.text: Charm, and we are head over heels in the embrace of a bad woman

indicators.note: being held in an embrace means sitting inside the letters of the bad woman

parts.note: bitch is an insulting word for a spiteful woman

indicators.note: turned head over heels, the word 'we' is flipped end to end in this down clue

explanation.surface: Fall for, and be thoroughly besotted while held by a wicked woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head over heels' turns WE into EW, which sits inside BITCH.
explanation.definitionFit: To charm someone is to enchant or cast a spell over them.

clue.text: Water which gives a duck employment

parts.note: a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so the letter O
employment of a tool is its use

explanation.surface: A pond that finds a job for a waterbird.
explanation.walkthrough: The OUSE is a river in England (there are two of that name); a duck is a cricketer's score of zero.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is a body of flowing stream, so it can be called water.

clue.text: Damage by giving the little devil breathing space

parts.note: an imp is a small mischievous devil
air is what we breathe, the space around us

explanation.surface: Harming someone by letting the mischief-maker have room to breathe.
explanation.definitionFit: To impair something is to weaken or harm it.

clue.text: Pollutions like an uncle rising behind the motorway

indicators.note: the following pieces come behind, after, the motorway in this down clue

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's first motorway, written MI
as means like

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: Uncle Sam stands for the USA, so SAM is an uncle

explanation.surface: Smog compared to an uncle climbing beyond the highway.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the London to Leeds motorway; its 1 serves as I. 'rising' turns SAM into MAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Miasmas are noxious vapours or foul air, a kind of contamination.

clue.text: Shifting tides or a heavenly body

indicators.note: shifting means the letters move around into a new order

explanation.surface: Moving waters or a planet in the sky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shifting' rearranges TIDES OR A.
explanation.definitionFit: A minor planet orbiting the sun is a celestial object.

clue.text: Give out anew what the king does without a fool

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the king's activity surrounds the fool

parts.note: a king reigns, so his activity is to reign
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: Redistribute the tasks a monarch performs, minus the jester.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it means outside: REIGN goes round ASS.
explanation.definitionFit: To allocate again is to hand something out afresh to someone new.

clue.text: A stern reaction

parts.note: the stern is the back of a boat, and the water thrown back from it is the reaction; also a reaction against something

explanation.surface: A severe response to something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stern' reads as 'severe' but is the rear of a ship: the wash thrown back from a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: The turbulence behind a moving boat, also a repercussion, is a disturbed flow driven back from the stern.

clue.text: Half a go in supernatural power for an Italian place

indicators.note: in puts the half piece inside the supernatural power

parts.note: mana is a Polynesian word for spiritual or magical power

indicators.note: half of the four letters gives the first two

parts.note: a go in a game is a turn

explanation.surface: A partial attempt at magic for a town in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: Half of TURN (a go) is TU, placed inside MANA.
explanation.definitionFit: Mantua is a city in Lombardy, northern Italy.

clue.text: Indicate a person is someone skilled in publicity

parts.note: to indicate is to show
a man is a person

explanation.surface: Point out that somebody is good at promotion.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer with a flair for promotion and attracting attention is a natural self-publicist.

clue.text: Thanks to an augury from parts of body

indicators.note: to means added to, so thanks is attached after the augury

parts.note: an augury is a sign or omen
ta is British informal for thanks

explanation.surface: Gratitude for a prophecy taken from bits of anatomy.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is British slang for thank you; 'to' says it is added to OMEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Omenta are folds of the peritoneum in the abdomen, membranes within the human frame.

clue.text: Caught a man before times for monsters

indicators.note: before puts the man ahead of the times

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
him refers to a man
eras are periods of time

explanation.surface: Arrested a fellow ahead of schedule because of beasts.
explanation.walkthrough: The page prints 'time', but the wordplay needs the plural ERAS.
explanation.definitionFit: A chimera is a fire-breathing creature of Greek myth, part lion, goat and serpent.

clue.text: He tries hard for a street flower

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street
a flower here is something that flows, a river

explanation.surface: A man putting in effort to get a road blossom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is not a bloom but a thing that flows.
explanation.definitionFit: One who makes great efforts toward a goal is a person working hard.

clue.text: Putting it in the best light, we turn to wood inside a fish

definitions.text: Putting it in the best light

indicators.note: inside puts the turned word and wood within the fish

parts.note: a whiting is a sea fish

indicators.note: turn means the word 'we' is reversed

parts.note: ash is a tree and its timber

explanation.surface: Showing it favourably, we become timber inside a fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' makes WE into EW; EW plus ASH go inside WHITING.
explanation.definitionFit: Glossing over faults to make something look good is covering up, as with a coat of paint.

clue.text: Press ace disappears among those who are breaking free

indicators.note: the letters of the words vanish as written and reappear in a new order

explanation.surface: A newspaper's star reporter goes missing among people making a getaway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disappears' rearranges PRESS ACE; 'among' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: People escaping from captivity are fugitives breaking out.

clue.text: Causes a disturbance thanks to the setup under a foreign soldier

indicators.note: in a down clue, under places these pieces below the soldier

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier
ta is British informal for thanks
read as 'set up': a set (group) written upwards in a down clue, so its letters come backwards

explanation.surface: Makes trouble, thanks to the arrangement beneath an alien fighter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setup' splits as SET plus 'up', which reverses it to TES in this down clue; GI is an American soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: To stir up and disturb people is to agitate them.

clue.text: Import since facing changes all round one

indicators.note: all round means the rearranged letters surround the numeral
changes means the letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Bringing goods in, given that the wording alters around one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Import' reads as a verb about trade but means meaning or importance.
explanation.definitionFit: The import of something is its meaning or importance.

clue.text: The perfume to excite

definitions.meaning: the fragrant smoke from burning resin or spices
to make someone very angry, with stress on the second syllable

explanation.definitionFit: One spelling serves as noun for aromatic smoke and as verb meaning to enrage.

clue.text: In cooking I do wrong in signal to next person performing

indicators.note: the second in puts the pieces inside the signal

parts.note: a cue tells an actor or musician when to start
to sin is to do wrong

explanation.surface: In the kitchen I make a mistake on a prompt to the next act.
explanation.walkthrough: A cue is the prompt telling the next performer to begin.
explanation.definitionFit: A style of preparing food is a kitchen's culinary tradition.

clue.text: Business which has to finish in a stove

indicators.note: in places the finish inside the stove

parts.note: an Aga is a British brand of cast-iron range cooker
to finish is to end

explanation.surface: A commercial matter that must be completed inside a cooker.
explanation.walkthrough: An AGA is a heavy cast-iron range cooker common in British country kitchens.
explanation.definitionFit: The items of business for a meeting are listed on its programme.

clue.text: The finder turns out to be an acquaintance

indicators.note: turns out signals that the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The person who found something proves to be someone you know.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns out' rearranges FINDER.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone you know personally and like is a companion or pal.

clue.text: Things from the papers cause a bit of pain in town

indicators.note: in puts the twinge inside the town

parts.note: Arles is a town in Provence
a tic is a twitch, as in tic douloureux, a stab of facial pain

explanation.surface: Newspaper items that cause a twinge in the city.
explanation.walkthrough: ARLES is a town in southern France; 'cause' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Newspaper pieces are written reports printed in a journal.

clue.text: The vocalist is a scorcher

definitions.meaning: a person who uses the voice musically
one who singes, burning something lightly

explanation.definitionFit: A performer of songs, and also a person who burns lightly, read as 'singe-er'.

clue.text: Car caught before the liquid in it rose

indicators.note: before places the caught letter ahead of the liquid

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: rose in a down clue means the word reads upwards, so backwards

parts.note: oil is the liquid that goes in a car's engine

explanation.surface: An automobile captured before its fuel climbed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rose' turns OIL into LIO in this down clue. The Clio is a Renault model.
explanation.definitionFit: The Renault Clio is a small hatchback model of motor vehicle.

clue.text: Enlarge the unstarted book which now has to finish

indicators.note: unstarted means the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: a text is a book
to finish is to end

explanation.surface: Make longer the book never begun that must now be completed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unstarted' removes the T from TEXT, leaving EXT.
explanation.definitionFit: To lengthen or stretch something is to make it bigger.

clue.text: Everything that is about can turn into an association

parts.note: all means everything

indicators.note: about means the abbreviation goes round the turned word

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

indicators.note: turn signals that the letters of 'can' are rearranged

explanation.surface: All that is surrounding a tin may become a partnership.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' rearranges CAN to ANC, which sits inside IE.
explanation.definitionFit: A league or union of parties is a formal grouping.

clue.text: If a county lost its capital it would give America something ensuring life

definitions.text: If a county lost its capital it would give America something ensuring life

parts.words: If a county lost its capital it would give America something ensuring life
parts.note: drop the first letter of an English county name and what remains is the US followed by the act that keeps the species going

explanation.surface: A region deprived of its chief city would leave the USA with a lifeline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like the chief city but is the capital letter: removing the initial S leaves US plus SEX.
explanation.definitionFit: The southern English shire, once a Saxon kingdom, whose name minus S gives the two parts.

clue.text: Spring surrounds one of us, going to my own place

indicators.note: surrounds means the novelist's name goes round the first person

parts.note: Howard Spring was a popular British novelist, so Spring's first name is Howard
me is one of us, the speaker

explanation.surface: A season enclosing one person, going back to my house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spring' is not the season but the novelist Howard Spring, whose first name goes round ME.
explanation.definitionFit: Heading towards one's house means travelling in the direction of one's dwelling.
